purpose: Test whether direct observed paired boundaries can fill the remaining Red Sea overflow width gap. A failed or underresolved attempt remains explicit; no threshold tuning to force a number.
section_support: 18February2001 nearly zonal section near12.183N,44.20-44.34E. Group chosen from source positions/cruise-log geography, without inspecting velocities. Local lower Northern Channel context, not the complete two-branch overflow or full current.
vertical_operator: Use complete paired u/v samples and actual reported heights. Interpolate only to in-range layer endpoints and integrate trapezoidally across the exact40m layer. At least3 original paired samples in the layer; no consecutive source gaps above20m, no extrapolation, no bridging missing samples.
reference_gate: Retain each source reference and processing tag. Uninterpretable reference or unresolved source component-quality treatment makes that profile unavailable. Cast10 has a documented bad downcast; inspect whether the distributed upf/up metadata explicitly supports retained upcast-only treatment before use. Never infer a good profile from the downup filename.
hydrography_rule: Match source cast identity and report position/time offsets. Where z is absent, use explicitly labelled TEOS-10 pressure-to-depth conversion at the source latitude; never equate dbar with metres. Interpolate salinity only within complete native support to the velocity layer; retain missing/extrapolation failures.
provisional_association_context: Source-consistent high-salinity descending plume context is assessed using layer salinity>=38psu and speed>=0.2m/s at the selected peak. These are OSW screening choices, not independently verified current identity or universal physical boundaries.
primary_velocity_component: southward=-v in earth coordinates, fixed cross-section orientation
peak_rule: Largest positive southward layer mean among the five casts, requiring>=0.2m/s. Ties to westernmost position. Do not switch components after observing failure.
paired_edge_rule: Walk adjacent section profiles from the peak to nearest threshold crossings on both sides. Missing profile or open section endpoint means unknown span. Do not close against a channel wall or extend the section to obtain a crossing.
geometry_rule: Interpolate each crossing within its neighboring source-position bracket; retain geographic endpoints, sampling brackets, timestamps and section obliquity. WGS84 geodesic separation is an explicitly stated calculation assumption, not independent validation of the historical source datum.
velocity_sensitivity_role: Finite perturbation context from the author's approximate winter quality summary, not a per-cast confidence interval or certified measurement error. Keep separate from boundary-choice, layer and spatial-sampling sensitivity.
resolution_rule: Report width relative to observed horizontal station spacings and the source40m vertical transfer scale. Fewer than4 horizontal spacings requires explicit resolution review; it is never relabelled a precise physical boundary.
admission_rule: Source identity, reference, tidal treatment, association, paired edges, orientation and resolution require review before any scoped width registration. Store feasibility results first; do not silently promote a fixed component section span to flow-normal whole-current width.
